source: exile-appraiser 內建範本(手寫);鍵 = 語料頁英文第一行 / 演算法頁項目 id,對應 data/regex/regex_poe*.json 與 regex/src/pages/

desc.zh: 排除 T17 常見的高危詞綴:藥劑效果降低、攻擊格擋、血漬鋸刃、核息、隕石、光環影響敵人、稀有怪復甦、偷取恢復降低。依 build 自行增減。
desc.en: Excludes common high-risk T17 modifiers: less flask effect, attack block, sawblades, volatile cores, meteors, auras affecting enemies, reviving rares, reduced leech. Adjust for your build.

map_mods: Players have #% less effect of Flasks applied to them
Monsters have #% Chance to Block Attack Damage
Players are assaulted by Bloodstained Sawblades
Players are targeted by a Meteor when they use a Flask
Auras from Player Skills which affect Allies also affect Enemies
Rare monsters in area Temporarily Revive on death
Players have #% reduced Maximum total Life, Mana and Energy Shield Recovery per second from Leech

name.zh: 地圖無反射 / 無 -最大抗性

desc.zh: 排除元素荊棘、物理荊棘(反射)與「玩家全部最大抗性降低」。
desc.en: Excludes elemental thorns, physical thorns (reflect) and reduced maximum resistances.

map_mods: Rare Monsters have [ElementalThorns|Elemental Thorns] reflecting # Elemental Damage
Rare Monsters have [PhysicalThorns|Physical Thorns] reflecting # Physical Damage
Players have #% to all maximum Resistances

desc.zh: 商店裡 6 連結的物品(插槽顯示 R-G-B 不翻譯的假設待實測)。
desc.en: 6-linked items in a vendor (assumes socket letters are not translated; untested in the zh client).

desc.zh: 紅綠藍相鄰連結(任意順序),賣給商人換彩色石。插槽字母假設待實測。
desc.en: Adjacent linked red, green and blue sockets in any order (vendor for Chromatic Orbs). Socket-letter assumption untested.

name.zh: 探險日誌 高價值(排除難打詞綴)

desc.zh: 日誌的詞綴不直接標示價值(清單只有怪物 / 玩家詞綴);這組排除反射、無法回復、-最大抗性,保留可以放心跑的日誌。
desc.en: Logbook modifiers do not state value directly (the list only has monster/player mods); this excludes reflect, no regeneration and -max res so the rest are safe to run.

logbook_mods: Rare Monsters have [ElementalThorns|Elemental Thorns] reflecting # Elemental Damage
Rare Monsters have [PhysicalThorns|Physical Thorns] reflecting # Physical Damage
Players cannot Regenerate Life, Mana or Energy Shield
Players have #% to all maximum Resistances

desc.zh: 排除玩家最大抗性降低、元素穿透、恢復率降低、額外混沌傷害、時空鎖鏈。依 build 自行增減。
desc.en: Excludes reduced max resistances, elemental penetration, less recovery, extra chaos damage and Temporal Chains. Adjust for your build.

waystone_mods: Players have #% less Recovery Rate of Life and Energy Shield
Monsters deal #% of Damage as Extra Chaos
Players are periodically Cursed with Temporal Chains

desc.zh: 通用碑牌中提高收益的詞綴:物品稀有度、換界石數量、額外隨機詞綴、怪物群大小(任一)。
desc.en: Generic tablet modifiers that raise rewards: item rarity, waystone quantity, additional random modifier, pack size (any of).

tablet_mods: #% increased Rarity of Items found in Map
#% increased Quantity of Waystones found in Map
